name: AASHTO & FHWA Soil Nail Design Suite
description: Comprehensive engineering suite for Soil Nail system design according to AASHTO LRFD (9th Ed, 2020) and FHWA-NHI-14-007 (GEC 7), featuring tendon sizing, bearing plate design, facing flexure & punching shear, corrosion protection classes, interactive CAD cross-sections, bilingual Persian/English UI, and PDF calculation booklet generation.
